boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented Saint John’s destinations for studying, making, recreation, reflection, and campus gathering.

cards.title: Sexton Commons
cards.subtitle: Campus center at Saint John’s University
cards.notes: Use the campus center as a practical meeting point: it includes lounge areas, a cafeteria, bookstore, and administrative offices.
cards.short_summary: A central building for everyday campus errands and meeting up.
cards.evidence_claim: The university catalog identifies Sexton Commons as a campus center with a bookstore, cafeteria, lounge areas, and administrative offices.
cards.source_title: Buildings and Facilities at Saint John's University
cards.access_notes: Sexton Commons is listed by campus security as open 6 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 6 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Alcuin Library
cards.subtitle: Library and learning hub at Saint John’s
cards.notes: Choose a study setting that fits your task, then use the information desk for help locating rooms or library support.
cards.short_summary: A library with designated active, focused, and quiet study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The library policy designates Alcuin’s upper level for active learning, lower level for focused study, and basement for quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Common library areas are generally public; reservable study rooms are restricted to current CSB+SJU students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Dietrich Reinhart Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Alcuin Library addition at Saint John’s
cards.notes: Set up for a group work session or a media task, and check the building’s linked support services when you need help.
cards.short_summary: A learning-focused addition connecting study and media resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The university catalog says the Dietrich Reinhart Learning Commons addition includes a coffee shop, video studio, and media services.
cards.source_title: Buildings and Facilities at Saint John's University
cards.access_notes: Located with Alcuin Library; consult library access information for current building availability.

cards.title: The Saint John’s Bible Gallery
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Alcuin Library
cards.notes: Take the self-guided gallery route: begin with the introductory video, then move through the display cases at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A gallery for viewing Saint John’s Bible materials and manuscript interpretation.
cards.evidence_claim: The university’s self-exploration guide places the gallery on Alcuin Library’s lower level and directs visitors through a self-tour.
cards.source_title: Experience The Saint John’s Bible and Ancient Manuscripts
cards.access_notes: The School of Theology and Seminary states that original pages are always on display; confirm current library access before visiting.

cards.title: Hill Museum & Manuscript Library
cards.subtitle: Manuscript-culture research library at Saint John’s
cards.notes: Visit with a specific question or simply orient yourself to the building’s manuscript-focused collections and research purpose.
cards.short_summary: A campus destination centered on preserving and studying manuscript cultures.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes HMML as holding the world’s largest collection of resources for studying manuscript cultures across several world regions.
cards.source_title: Our Campus | Saint John’s School of Theology and Seminary
cards.access_notes: The university notes that HMML keeps regular hours during the academic year and summer; verify current hours before arrival.

cards.entity_name: Saint John’s Abbey and University Church
cards.title: Saint John’s Abbey and University Church
cards.subtitle: Abbey and University Church at Saint John’s
cards.notes: Pause for a quiet visit or attend an announced service; use the campus schedule and church guidance for current worship details.
cards.short_summary: A named campus site for worship, reflection, and sacred music.
cards.evidence_claim: The university catalog identifies the Abbey and University Church and its Chapel of Saint John the Baptist and Assumption Chapel.
cards.source_title: Buildings and Facilities at Saint John's University
cards.access_notes: Campus security directs visitors to current Abbey Church hours; access and services vary by schedule.

cards.title: Student Beach
cards.subtitle: Designated beach on Lake Sagatagan
cards.notes: Check in with the lifeguards before swimming, or use the beach’s equipment checkout for a supervised paddle on the lake.
cards.short_summary: A designated Lake Sagatagan access point for swimming and nonmotorized boating.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that the beach offers swimming and canoe, kayak, and paddleboard rentals, with lifeguard check-in required.
cards.source_title: Lake Sagatagan | Saint John’s Athletics and Recreation
cards.access_notes: The beach page lists seasonal hours and limits beach access to CSB+SJU students, faculty, staff, and alumni; confirm the current season and hours.

cards.title: Saint John’s Abbey Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Outdoor U nature sanctuary beside Saint John’s
cards.notes: Pick a mapped trail for a walk, run, or ski, and follow the posted land rules—especially trail and water-safety restrictions.
cards.short_summary: A large campus-adjacent natural area with mapped trails and stewardship guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoor U describes the Abbey Arboretum as a nature sanctuary, and its trail map documents named trails and visitor guidelines.
cards.source_title: Saint John’s Abbey Arboretum – Nature Sanctuary
cards.access_notes: Use the official trail map and respect Abbey land restrictions; swimming is limited to the designated beach area with a lifeguard on duty.

cards.title: Warner Palaestra
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation center at Saint John’s
cards.notes: Plan an indoor recreation session around the facility you need, such as the pool, fitness center, arena, or Spectrum space.
cards.short_summary: The main Saint John’s recreation building with several indoor activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint John’s Athletics and Recreation calls the Warner Palaestra its primary recreation center and lists its fitness center, pool, Sexton Arena, and McNeely Spectrum.
cards.access_notes: University access policies apply; the fitness center requires users to be at least 18 and part of the campus community or university lodging guests.

cards.title: Art Center
cards.subtitle: Art studios and Rogers Gallery at Saint John’s
cards.notes: Look for a Rogers Gallery exhibition or use the building as a reference point when heading to an art class, studio, or lecture.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated arts building with studio, classroom, lecture, and gallery spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The university catalog lists the Art Center’s studios, classrooms, lecture hall, Alice R. Rogers Gallery, and senior studios.
cards.source_title: Buildings and Facilities at Saint John's University
cards.access_notes: Campus security lists the Art Center as open from 6 a.m. to midnight; room and exhibition access can vary.
